epic.title: Search & Manage Cards
epic.description: Core functionality for searching, viewing, filtering, and managing card information across the system

stories.title: Card Search Interface
stories.description: Implement advanced search interface with filters for account, customer, card status and sort options
stories.acceptance_criteria: Users can search for cards using multiple filter options with typeahead autocomplete

stories.title: Search Results Table
stories.description: Display search results in organized, sortable table with pagination support
stories.acceptance_criteria: Search results display in table format with sorting, pagination, and selection capabilities

stories.title: View Card Details
stories.description: Display comprehensive card information with multiple sections and lazy-loaded content
stories.acceptance_criteria: Users can click on card to view detailed information with accordion sections

stories.title: Edit Card Information
stories.description: Allow inline editing of card data with validation, save, and cancel functionality
stories.acceptance_criteria: Card details can be edited with proper validation and error handling

stories.title: Bulk Operations
stories.description: Enable selection and bulk updates to multiple cards with confirmation workflows
stories.acceptance_criteria: Multiple cards can be selected and bulk operations applied with user confirmation

status_workflow.pending: Story not yet published to Jira
status_workflow.synced: Story published to Jira and hash matches
status_workflow.needs_update: Story updated since last sync, needs re-publish
